finish.summary:
Bug: "Clear Data" in Weaviate Vector Store (node version >= 1.1) deleted the collection or tenant inside `populateVectorStore`, which is called once per batch. With multiple batches (more than `embeddingBatchSize` documents), only the last batch survived because the store was cleared before each batch.

Fix: Moved the clear logic from `populateVectorStore` to the `beforeInsert` hook, which the batch insert operation (`insertOperation.ts`) calls exactly once before the first batch. The `beforeInsert` hook is the designated API for one-time setup (clearing an index), per its JSDoc in `types.ts`.

Changes:
- `VectorStoreWeaviate.node.ts`: Added `beforeInsert` method with the clear-store logic; removed the same logic from `populateVectorStore`, which now only inserts documents.
- `VectorStoreWeaviate.node.test.ts`: Added `beforeInsert` test block (delete collection, remove tenant, no-op when clear is off); updated `populateVectorStore` tests to verify it no longer clears data; updated the mock factory to also expose `beforeInsert`.
finish.risks: Low risk. The `beforeInsert` hook was already designed for this purpose and works identically for the v1 version path (non-batched). The Azure AI Search node already uses this same pattern. The change is well-tested with 27 passing tests.
